candidate_text:
From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus.

To all of God’s holy people in Philippi who belong to Christ Jesus, together with the leaders and assistants:

May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

warrant_checker.evidence: No broad commentary layer or unrelated explanatory material is introduced.

communication_readability_checker.evidence: Candidate uses current vocabulary, explicit referents, and manageable sentence structure for the target reader.

discourse_cohesion_checker.evidence: Major logical and rhetorical progression of the source unit remains visible.

matrix_precedent_checker.evidence: “Servants” is accessible but may understate allegiance/status; Matrix footnote policy should remain available.
“Leaders and assistants” is plain-language and consistent with FLT precedent, but should be logged as scoped ecclesial terminology.

ambiguity_scope_checker.evidence: Rendered relationally as belonging to Christ; clear and contextually defensible.

checker_independence_note: Procedural role separation only; same assistant environment.
